the SIMPLE experiment excludes the existence of a WIMP with a mass between 35 and 60  GeV and a cross section greater than 5.7× 10(-3)pb in the spin-dependent interaction channel, and greater than 4.7 × 10(-6)pb in the SI channel.

the SIMPLE experiment excludes a large part of the WIMP parameter space, including a large region of interest, and that it is now possible to make a definitive statement that the WIMP is not a significant contributor to the galactic dark matter halo.
